rows.name: Programme Management & AI Delivery Governance
Mobilisation: NDA, SOW/PO, access; AI toolchain set up under SportSeek-approved terms (D21)
Kick-off workshop (SportSeek + Srivin)
Release-train plan, RAID log, governance charter, AI usage policy
Governance cadence: daily stand-up, weekly demo & status, monthly release review / steering
Change control (SOW Section 18) — ongoing; scope flexes between trains, dates do not
Phase 2A closure: completion report, lessons learned, Phase 2B readiness
Release R1 — Public Launch + F3 Shared Identity (20 Oct 2026)
AI-assisted Phase 1 assessment: codebase map, ERD, API inventory, auth/user tables, dependency & security scan, defect triage
Launch Scope Gate: launch scope, go-live criteria, F3 scope and fallback confirmed
Environment, CI/CD & observability refinement (launch-critical)
AI-generated regression suite for all live Phase 1 journeys (API + mobile)
Remediation of critical/high Phase 1 defects in launch scope
F3 — Identity design & ADR-01: linking rules, identifiers, role model, KYC fields, token design
F3 — Identity service in .NET (OIDC client per app; one credential & profile; multi-role; KYC status on identity)
F3 — OTP-verified account linking and role assignment in User & Partner app registration (React Native) + Admin role view
F3 — Bootstrap: load all existing User & Partner accounts 1:1 into the identity store (duplicates merged in R2)
F3 — Remote feature flag with fallback to Phase 1 login; minimum-version enforcement
Security baseline: SAST, dependency & DAST; VAPT of launch surface + targeted identity pen test
Performance / load test at launch concurrency, incl. login and OTP flows
Store & compliance readiness: listings, privacy policy, DPDP notice/consent, account deletion
Code freeze & Release Candidate (F3 behind flag)
App store submissions & review window
Full regression + identity/VAPT retest + UAT incl. account-linking scenarios
Launch runbook, rollback plan (incl. F3 switch-off), on-call rota, war-room
Go / No-Go (separate decision: F3 on or off at launch)
R1 LIVE — public launch with F3 Shared Identity
Hypercare (daily triage, identity and login monitoring)
Discovery, Architecture & Design (AI-assisted, runs alongside launch)
AI-generated as-is documentation: architecture, ERD, API catalogue, integration map
Story mapping for F1, F2, F4–F12; AI-drafted stories & acceptance criteria refined with PO
HLD & remaining ADRs (event bus, service-type model, web framework); identity ADR-01 taken in R1
HLD sign-off
Design system (atomic) with AI-assisted exploration; tokens shared by mobile & web
Design system approval
Feature specs, UI and LLD — produced one train ahead of build (spec-driven development)
Closure of SOW open items (ledger visibility, alert catalog, SLAs, NFRs, refund policy, Route)
Platform Foundation (M1) — built in the first build cycle
Infrastructure-as-Code; Dev / Staging / Prod promotion
CI/CD quality gates incl. AI code review, SAST, dependency & secret scanning, coverage
Event bus (transactional outbox), API Gateway/BFF, feature-flag service
M1 Foundation accepted
Release R2 — F1 Email, F2 Reminders, F4 Push & Preferences (24 Nov 2026)
F1 — Email notifications for all live alert triggers (booking, registration, payment)
F2 — Booking & event reminders (T-24h, T-2h) by Email/SMS/Push
F4 — Push notifications (FCM/APNs) + role-scoped notification preferences + cross-app deep links
Enabler — reconciliation & merge of existing duplicate accounts (approved merge rules)
Hardening: regression, identity-merge dry-run sign-off, UAT; store submission
R2 LIVE — F1, F2, F4; duplicate accounts merged
Hypercare + KT checklist sign-off (R2)
Release R3 — F5 Cancellation & Refunds, F6 Web App (Players) (22 Dec 2026)
F5 — Cancellation & refunds for bookings and tournament registrations (gateway refund API, policy rules)
F6 — Web app for players: search, availability, booking, event registration, payments
Hardening: regression, targeted pen test on refunds, UAT; store submission
R3 LIVE — F5, F6
Hypercare + KT checklist sign-off (R3)
Release R4 — F7 Generalised Partner Model, F8 Waitlist & Edit Alerts (27 Jan 2027)
F7 — Generalised partner/service model; coach, physio, nutritionist enabled by admin configuration
F8 — Waitlist with time-boxed offers + event-edited-after-publish notifications
Hardening: facility regression, UAT; store submission (reduced capacity over year-end)
R4 LIVE — F7, F8
Hypercare + KT checklist sign-off (R4)
Release R5 — F9 Transaction Ledger, F10 Web App (Organisers & Partners) (23 Feb 2027)
F9 — Transaction Ledger: webhook ingestion + reconciliation, admin history/detail, PDF/CSV export, refund tracker
F10 — Web app for organisers & partners: events, tournaments, scoring, service & booking management
Hardening: reconciliation check vs gateway, UAT; store submission
R5 LIVE — F9, F10
Hypercare + KT checklist sign-off (R5)
Release R6 — F11 Split Settlement & Partner Payouts, F12 WhatsApp & Full Alert Catalog (23 Mar 2027)
F11 — Razorpay Route onboarding for all partner types + partner settlement view (web)
F12 — WhatsApp channel + full SOW Section 10.2 alert catalog
Enabler — offline import tools for completed-event data
Hardening: full end-to-end regression, performance test, full VAPT (pre-completion), UAT
R6 LIVE — F11, F12 — PHASE 2A COMPLETE
Hypercare
Infrastructure operations runbook & transition plan (SOW 15.1)
Final KT: platform operations and architecture walkthrough
Phase 2A acceptance & KT checklist sign-off
Continuous Support Obligations
Phase 1 production monitoring & bug fixes (SOW Section 16)
90-day warranty per release (R1 → 18 Jan 2027 … R6 → 21 Jun 2027)
